claims.statement: Jem Mace beat Tom Allen at the Bowery Theatre for $10,000.
claims.excerpt: me after I beat ‘Tom Allen at the Bowery

fights.excerpt: me after I beat ‘Tom Allen at the Bowery
fights.notes: Stated by Mace in a 1883 interview. The text gives no date, round count or city; the hint's 1870 is not in the text.

notes: Allen appears only as the man Mace beat.
